---

This dataset is intentionally designed to contain:
- normal operational variation,
- gradual drift,
- low-pressure excursions,
- high-pressure anomalies,
- possible outliers,
- and mild nonstationary behavior.

In other words:
a realistic infrastructure dataset instead of nine lonely numbers standing in a field pretending to be statistics.

Now you can:
- compute rolling statistics,
- test normality assumptions,
- evaluate outliers,
- perform Monte Carlo simulation,
- estimate probabilities,
- explore Bayesian updates,
- or even build a simple anomaly detection pipeline.

Which is how innocent “learning exercises” eventually become entire research directions.
